chapters.title: Twitter Space Troubles and JavaScript Jam Introductions
chapters.description: The hosts bounce back from a Twitter Space glitch that taught them patience. Ishan introduces JavaScript Jam Live as an open mic for JavaScript and web development, then Anthony and Scott introduce themselves from Edgio, announcing the React Miami collaboration with upcoming speakers, extra goodies, and an open invitation for audience participation.

chapters.title: Guest Introductions and the Miami Jam Game Show
chapters.description: Dev Agrawal introduces himself as a React Miami media partner, Michelle checks in as an event organizer, and Dan explains his absence. Dev then unveils Miami Jam, a trivia-style game show where speakers tackle quirky JavaScript and React questions and the audience awards points, running to the recording's final timestamp at 00:08:42.
